Fix: use `[Tt][Aa][Gg]` instead of inline flags. Also `re.S` unnecessary. Let me fix PARAM_RE.

Also the tag value: `TOKEN_PLUS` is `+` so 1-128 needs a bound; let me use `{1,128}` with a single char class. Let me define TOKEN_CH = r"[A-Za-z0-9.!%*_+`'~\-]" and TOKEN_PLUS = TOKEN_CH + "+" and in PARAM_RE use TOKEN_CH + "{1,128}".
